title: Card - Highlight Dark
description: Fixed-dark highlight card shell for the Blog Hero's featured-article tile, reusing the same on-dark-card surface pairing as Card - CTA Inline. Radius matches Card - Post (the other new card family added for the Blog archive) so both new cards read as one consistent shape language. Border uses border.on-dark (constant across the light/dark toggle) rather than border.card, which flips and would go low-contrast against this always-dark card in light mode.
